modelingNotes: Exact Weidmüller order 1208600000: HDC 16B ABU — size 6 bulkhead housing. This model is the housing itself; separately ordered contact inserts and their electrical ratings are not included.

Mechanical housing scope with zero documented electrical terminals. The manufacturer outline and ordering data do not establish a dedicated housing PE/bonding terminal inventory or its internal bonding path. Preserve partial connection coverage; do not infer continuity through the body, mounting hardware, gland threads, clamp or separately ordered insert.

No pins or fixed links are authored for undocumented bonding interfaces. This omission is not evidence of isolation or proof of an installed bond. A mounting/assembly instruction is needed to extend that inventory.
IP65 applies to a specified closed or mated assembly with suitable seals and cable entries; the bare housing does not establish installed protection. No electrical voltage/current rating is assigned.
Mechanical connector descriptions are documentation only and do not create a communication link or electrical net.
